user_stories.title: Create case_state_manager module with Mnesia schema
acceptance_criteria: Mnesia tables case_commit and case_latest are created with correct indexes
case_state_manager:start_link/0 starts gen_server successfully
case_state_manager:init_schema/0 creates tables or returns ok if already exists
Unit tests pass: rebar3 eunit --module=case_state_manager
Dialyzer shows no errors for case_state_manager module
user_stories.notes: Create new module at /Users/sac/cre/src/wf/case_state_manager.erl with Mnesia tables for atomic commit log

user_stories.title: Implement commit/4 function with atomic Mnesia transaction
acceptance_criteria: commit/4 accepts CaseId, Marking, UsrInfo, Effects and returns {ok, CommitId, Receipt}
Commit writes to both case_commit and case_latest tables in single Mnesia transaction
Commit record includes: commit_id (UUID v4), case_id, parent_commit_id, marking, usr_info, rng_state, effects_receipt, timestamp, version
Receipt includes: commit_id, before_hash (SHA-256), after_hash (SHA-256), effects, timestamp
Parent commit pointer correctly references previous commit or undefined for initial commit
Unit tests verify transaction atomicity (simulate crash during write)
Version increments correctly in commit chain
user_stories.notes: Core atomic commit protocol. Reference Mnesia transaction pattern from yawl_recovery:303-322

user_stories.title: Implement read functions: get_state/2, get_commit/2, get_commit_history/1
acceptance_criteria: get_state/2 reads from case_latest and case_commit tables, returns {ok, Marking, UsrInfo, Effects}
get_commit/2 reads specific commit by commit_id, returns {ok, #case_commit{}}
get_commit_history/1 returns all commits for case sorted by version ascending
All read functions use Mnesia transactions for consistency
get_commit_history/1 returns empty list for non-existent case
Unit tests verify read-after-write consistency
Performance test: 1000 reads/sec per case
user_stories.notes: Read operations are hot path - optimize with Mnesia dirty_ops if needed

user_stories.title: Implement rollback/2 function
acceptance_criteria: rollback/2 accepts CaseId and TargetCommitId, updates case_latest pointer
Rollback verifies target commit exists and belongs to specified case
Rollback is atomic (single Mnesia transaction)
After rollback, get_state/2 returns target commit's state
Rollback aborts if target commit_id not found
Unit tests verify rollback to previous commit and verify state matches
Integration test: rollback then create new commit verifies new commit branches from rollback point
user_stories.notes: Rollback just moves pointer - commits are append-only, no deletion

user_stories.title: Integrate case_state_manager into wf_engine start_case/3
acceptance_criteria: wf_engine:init/1 starts case_state_manager if not already running
start_case/3 creates initial commit via case_state_manager:commit/4
Initial commit contains marking from spec initial_marking and data from Opts
wf_case record created with case_id, status=running, data, but marking=undefined (stored in commit)
Commit history shows 1 commit after start_case/3
Error handling: if commit fails, start_case/3 returns {error, {commit_failed, Reason}}
user_stories.notes: This begins migration of wf_engine from in-memory state to commit-based state

user_stories.title: Modify wf_engine complete_workitem/6 to use case_state_manager commit
acceptance_criteria: complete_workitem/6 calls case_state_manager:get_state/2 to load current marking before firing transition
After firing transition, complete_workitem/6 calls case_state_manager:commit/4 atomically
Commit includes: new marking, merged data, effects [{transition, Task}, {work_item_completed, WiId}, {produce_map, ProduceMap}]
If commit succeeds, work item status updated to completed and wf_case updated
If commit fails, error logged and old state preserved (no partial update)
Commit history shows N+1 commits after completing N work items
Legacy receipt still created for backwards compatibility
user_stories.notes: Critical change - moves state mutation from in-memory to atomic commits. Reference existing complete_workitem at wf_engine:1240-1285

user_stories.title: Add load_case_marking/1 helper to wf_engine

Used by process_enabled/3, check_completion/3, fire_enabled_transition/5 to access marking

user_stories.title: Migrate gen_yawl to use case_state_manager instead of yawl_recovery checkpoints
acceptance_criteria: gen_yawl init/1 sets checkpoint_interval = 0 in wrapper_state
handle_cast(continue, ...) extracts case_id from net_arg
After progress/4 produces new marking, gen_yawl calls case_state_manager:commit/4
Commit includes effects: [{transition, Trsn}, {mode, Mode}, {produce_map, Pm}]
Commit replaces yawl_recovery:maybe_checkpoint/5 call (removed)
If commit succeeds, gen_yawl continues with new marking
If commit fails, error logged and execution halts (does not continue with inconsistent state)
Commit history shows commits for each gen_yawl step
yawl_recovery checkpoint table not written to (verify with query)
user_stories.notes: Eliminates independent checkpoint path. Reference gen_yawl:994-1000 for removed checkpoint code

user_stories.title: Implement verify_replay/1 for commit chain validation
